title: "rungar providers disable"
description: "Take a provider out of placement, leaving its runners to finish"
---

Take a provider out of placement: no new runner goes to it, and the runners on it are left to finish their jobs. It lasts until the daemon restarts, which goes back to what the configuration says: set disabled there to make it last.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar providers disable NAME
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
